<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Each node has a page with its settings. In the editor, the node list on the left holds them all, grouped the same way. How items flow between them is in [Concepts](/docs/guides/concepts/).

## Triggers

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Manual](/docs/reference/nodes/triggers/manual/) | `trigger.manual` | Starts the workflow when you run it by hand. |
| [Market activity](/docs/reference/nodes/triggers/market/) | `trigger.market` | Starts the workflow on live trades, book changes or resolutions of the chosen tokens, batched per window. |
| [Order activity](/docs/reference/nodes/triggers/order-activity/) | `trigger.orderActivity` | Starts the workflow on what happens to its own orders after the runs that placed them: a resting order filling, what is left of it cancelled or expired, a live trade failing on chain. |
| [Schedule](/docs/reference/nodes/triggers/schedule/) | `trigger.schedule` | Starts the workflow at a fixed interval. |
| [Telegram message](/docs/reference/nodes/triggers/telegram/) | `trigger.telegram` | Starts the workflow when you send the instance's bot a message, one item per message. |
| [Wallet activity](/docs/reference/nodes/triggers/wallet-activity/) | `trigger.walletActivity` | Starts the workflow on the trades of the traders you follow as they happen, about two seconds after: a trade each item, its fills summed. |

## Polymarket

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Balance](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/balance/) | `polymarket.balance` | Reads the USDC collateral balance of one of your wallets. |
| [Markets](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/markets/) | `polymarket.markets` | Looks up markets, one item per market. |
| [Order books](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/orderbook/) | `polymarket.orderbook` | Adds the current order book of each outcome to market items: best prices, spread and depth. |
| [Open orders](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/orders/) | `polymarket.orders` | Lists the open orders of one of your wallets. |
| [Positions](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/positions/) | `polymarket.positions` | Lists the open positions of one of your wallets, one item per position. |
| [Price change](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/price-change/) | `polymarket.priceChange` | Compares each outcome's price now with its price a while ago: the change in cents and in percent, for spotting markets on the move. |
| [Search markets](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/search/) | `polymarket.search` | Finds markets by words in their title, e.g. bitcoin or election, one item per market. |
| [Recent trades](/docs/reference/nodes/polymarket/trades/) | `polymarket.trades` | Lists the recent trades of each market, one item per trade, with its value in dollars: for spotting large buyers and sellers. |

## Logic

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Consensus](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/consensus/) | `logic.consensus` | Lets an item on once enough different traders agreed within a while: at 2 in 6h, a trade goes on when another trader made the same one in the 6 hours before. |
| [Only new](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/dedupe/) | `logic.dedupe` | Passes an item only the first time it shows up, so an alert fires once instead of on every run. |
| [Filter](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/filter/) | `logic.filter` | Keeps the items that pass its tests and drops the others: a number compared with a value, text that contains a value, or a field being there at all. |
| [If](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/if/) | `logic.if` | Tests each item and routes it to true or false: a number compared with a value, text that contains a value, or a field being there at all. |
| [Merge](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/merge/) | `logic.merge` | Combines the items of two branches, A and B, matched on a field: those in both, in either, only in A or in only one, or A's with B's item added. |
| [Sample](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/sample/) | `logic.sample` | Takes about a share of the items, each the same way every time: at 30, about 3 in 10 go on, and the rest leave from rest. |
| [Switch](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/switch/) | `logic.switch` | Sends each item out of the port of the first rule it passes, each rule a test like If's; the items no rule takes leave from other. |
| [Throttle](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/throttle/) | `logic.throttle` | Lets at most so many items through in a period, like 3 copies of a trader a day, counted per value of a field or all together; the rest leave from limited. |
| [Wait](/docs/reference/nodes/logic/wait/) | `logic.wait` | Holds the items for a while, or until a time of day, then passes them on. |

## Transform

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Keep fields](/docs/reference/nodes/transform/pick/) | `transform.pick` | Keeps only the fields you name on each item and drops the rest, so outputs and messages stay short. |
| [Split out](/docs/reference/nodes/transform/split-out/) | `transform.splitOut` | Makes an item of each entry of a list field, like a market's outcomes, with the other fields of the item it came from. |
| [Top items](/docs/reference/nodes/transform/top/) | `transform.top` | Sorts the items by a number and keeps the first few, e.g. the five markets with the most liquidity. |

## Output

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Log](/docs/reference/nodes/output/log/) | `output.log` | Writes a line to the server log for each item and passes the items on. |
| [Webhook](/docs/reference/nodes/output/webhook/) | `output.webhook` | Sends items to a web address: a message to a Discord or Slack channel, or the items as JSON to any service that takes them. |

## Telegram

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Telegram question](/docs/reference/nodes/telegram/ask/) | `telegram.ask` | Asks you on Telegram, with a button per answer, and waits. |
| [Telegram message](/docs/reference/nodes/telegram/send/) | `telegram.send` | Sends items to you on Telegram, in your chat with the instance's bot. |

## Code

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Code: aggregate](/docs/reference/nodes/code/aggregate/) | `code.aggregate` | Sums the items up with TypeScript: run(items, ctx) is called once with all of them and returns one item. |
| [Code: filter](/docs/reference/nodes/code/filter/) | `code.filter` | Keeps the items TypeScript says to keep: keep(item, ctx) is called for each item and returns true to keep it. |
| [Code: route](/docs/reference/nodes/code/route/) | `code.route` | Sends each item down the route TypeScript picks: route(item, ctx) is called for each item and returns one of the Routes. |
| [Code: transform](/docs/reference/nodes/code/transform/) | `code.transform` | Turns the items into others with TypeScript: run(items, ctx) is called once with all of them and returns the items to send on. |

## Trading

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Cancel orders](/docs/reference/nodes/trading/cancel-orders/) | `trading.cancelOrders` | Cancels the workflow's own orders resting on the book, for each item: the item's order, all of them, or those of a market or an outcome. |
| [Copy sizing](/docs/reference/nodes/trading/copy-size/) | `trading.copySize` | Works out a copy of each trade a followed trader made: how much to buy, or how much of your copy to sell, and at what price. |
| [Place order](/docs/reference/nodes/trading/place-order/) | `trading.placeOrder` | Places an order for each item, on paper or live as the workflow trades: the copy Copy sizing worked out, or one of its own settings, at once or resting on the book. |
| [Place orders](/docs/reference/nodes/trading/place-orders/) | `trading.placeOrders` | Places a list of orders for each item, together, on paper or live as the workflow trades: live, they reach Polymarket in one request, 15 at a time. |
| [Risk guard](/docs/reference/nodes/trading/risk-guard/) | `trading.riskGuard` | Holds copies of buys to the workflow's limits: caps a copy, a market and a day, a price band and categories. |

## AI

| Node | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [AI agent](/docs/reference/nodes/ai/agent/) | `ai.agent` | Asks a language model, with your own key, for each item or once for all of them: a prompt with expressions, the answer as text or as JSON in the shape you give, added to the item with the tokens it took. |
| [Local agent](/docs/reference/nodes/ai/local-agent/) | `ai.localAgent` | Hands a task to one of your own agents, such as Claude Code or Codex connected with the tasks scope, and waits for its answer: for each item or once for all of them, as text or as JSON in the shape you give. |
